I also note that the topology_boundary_auditor shows a high mask confidence score (0.9503), but the mask image reveals some irregularities at the tail and leg boundaries, which may indicate subtle fusion artifacts that the Router missed. The geometric_depth_auditor evidence does not show obvious grounding failures, but the depth statistics alone are not conclusive.
